AcademyCore.name: Fleet Academy / Core
AcademyCore.environment: Bright, ordered academic and technical environments with mature Fleet infrastructure, working archives, simulation rooms, and students from multiple regions.
AcademyCore.tone: Institutional confidence deliberately challenged by historical evidence and competing lived experience.
AcademyCore.political: The Academy teaches Fleet doctrine but also preserves disagreement about how that doctrine should be applied.

EarlyPostBreak.name: Early Post-Break Territories
EarlyPostBreak.environment: Fragmented settlements and damaged routes operating without dependable network continuity.
EarlyPostBreak.tone: Urgent practical survival, improvised exchange, and unresolved authority.
EarlyPostBreak.political: The later categories of Core, Verge, and Shards are only beginning to form; do not impose mature faction identities onto these communities.
